Battlegrounds comp · Season 14

Snazzy Phantom Reborn Conversion

solo undead Verified 2026-08-10
Required

Core

The engine pieces that make the comp work.

Snazzy Phantom Tier 6 · Undead 2.8% / refresh Barrier Banshee Tier 5 · Undead 3.3% / refresh Drustfallen Butcher Tier 5 · Undead 3.3% / refresh
Optional package

Add-ons

Permanent support and scaling pieces.

Cadaver Caretaker Tier 3 · Undead 6.7% / refresh Plaguerunner Portrait 1.7% / offer Jailer Sticker 1.7% / offer

Rarity is the chance to see that card in one eligible refresh or offer, assuming the needed tribe is active and the Solo pool is full and uncontested. Generated minions are labeled instead of given a false shop percentage; trinkets use a clearly marked catalog baseline because offer eligibility varies.

Game plan

Build a large stat reservoir with Barrier BansheeTier 5, move those stats through Drustfallen ButcherTier 5, and use Snazzy PhantomTier 6 to convert Reborn attack into additional growth on the rightmost Undead.

Cadaver CaretakerTier 3 is an early Deathrattle bridge visible in the source, but the mature board revolves around the Banshee–Butcher–Snazzy chain.

How to build it

  • Bridge: take outside-combat destruction and Reborn pieces that preserve tempo.
  • Commit: Banshee plus a way to transfer or reuse its stats is the signal.
  • Scale: set up Reborn before relying on Snazzy Phantom; the source repeatedly checks that requirement.
  • Finish: keep the intended recipient as the rightmost Undead and remove weak units that interfere with the chain.

Positioning and traps

Rightmost placement is functional, not cosmetic. A last-second utility swap can redirect an entire turn of scaling to the wrong body.

Do not treat Snazzy as a standalone carry. Without Reborn attack to convert, it is only occupying a premium slot and looking pleased with itself.

Jailer–Plaguerunner variant

dogdog's Jailer game shows a stronger hero-specific route into the same Snazzy conversion engine. Plaguerunner PortraitTrinket makes outside-combat Plaguerunner sacrifices replace themselves, while Jailer StickerTrinket turns disposable Undead into two fresh bodies. That extra generation makes it easier to find Reborn fuel and keep Drustfallen ButcherTier 5 active without freezing the board.

The important sequencing clarification comes at 17:50: Butchering can build the attack bank, but Snazzy copies the Attack of the Reborn unit, not the stats the unit had before dying. Position the intended recipient as your rightmost Undead, preserve enough actual Reborn bodies, and do not count a giant pre-death body as guaranteed Snazzy value.

Demonstrated payoff

The source wins the lobby and the final recruit phase at 21:47 visibly shows permanent bodies at 924/773, 604/469, and 335/245 before combat. Undead does not need to imitate a pure shop-scaling tribe: the guide is valid because the Reborn transfer chain is online, the recipient order is deliberate, and the board converts those stats into a first-place combat—not because every slot crosses an arbitrary four-digit threshold.

The additional dogdog source reinforces the same finish: Snazzy appears around 13:56, the Reborn-stat interaction is explained at 17:50, and the run closes first at 25:44.
